name: cooking-multiplex
description: Multiplex recipe hypergraph spanning multiple cuisines. Nodes represent ingredients. Each hyperedge represents a recipe and contains the set of ingredients used in that recipe. Layers correspond to different cuisine collections.

hypergraph_metadata.name: (STRING) Dataset name (e.g., cooking-multiplex).
hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., false).

nodes_metadata.name: (STRING) Name of the food ingredient (e.g., romaine lettuce).

edges_metadata.layer: (INT) Multiplex layer identifier corresponding to the cuisine collection (e.g., 16).
